eligibility: run if and only if Day 54 implementation passes and both reciprocal scientific gates pass
evidence_class: result-contingent new interventions on the unchanged 26-example development sandbox
hypothesis: if exact donor K12 transfers donor identity, the Day 52 QKV shortfall is caused by a missing subset of the selected natural donor head outputs
base_intervention: the unchanged numerically anchored Day 52 full-monitoring-prefix QKV operation
completion_delta: for a specified selected head, replace its Day 52 QKV-produced raw output with the exact natural donor raw output while leaving every other selected head at its QKV-produced value

candidates.selection: exhaustive single-head and layer-group localization; no outcome-based candidate addition or removal

primary_localization_estimand.formula: dot(candidate - qkv_baseline, exact_donor_k12_all - qkv_baseline) / max(norm(exact_donor_k12_all - qkv_baseline)^2, 1e-8)
primary_localization_estimand.reduction: equal response tokens within example, two-example concept mean, equal-concept median and donor-nearest concept count

control.definition: per-head Haar rotation of the exact-donor-minus-QKV selected-head completion delta at identical per-head norm and temporal Gram

interpretation.localized: name every head or layer with median complete-probe repair recovery at least 0.50, advantage over Haar at least 0.25, and improvement of donor-nearest probe identity in at least two concepts in either direction
interpretation.distributed: if exact completion repairs donor identity but no single head or layer qualifies, report the missing monitor-sensitive component as distributed across selected heads/layers
interpretation.boundary: localizes the QKV shortfall only; does not rehabilitate Day 52 as a complete controller

forbidden: selecting only favorable concepts, heads, layers, or directions
fresh data, behavior, generation, or title upgrade
